remarks: A rare, attention-grabbing opportunity in the heart of Wilton-36 Scribner Hill Road invites visionaries, builders, and investors to create something truly exceptional. Set on 2 private acres in one of the town's most coveted and picturesque locations, this property is surrounded by natural beauty and distinguished homes, offering a setting that is both serene and highly desirable. Opportunities like this are increasingly rare. The existing residence is in fair to poor condition and requires extensive renovation, or may be best suited for a complete reimagination. With a substantial footprint and expansive acreage, the possibilities are undeniable-restore, expand, or build new. An incredible canvas to design and craft a dream home in a premier location. Property is being sold strictly "AS-IS." Some personal property may remain. All investigations regarding future use, improvements, or redevelopment should be completed with the town following closing. Use caution when touring the property. For those with vision, this is more than a property-it's a chance to unlock extraordinary potential in one of Wilton's most sought-after settings.
